Name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. */ const ChoiceCardGroup = React.forwardRef< React.ElementRef, React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) ChoiceCardGroup.displayName = "ChoiceCardGroup" export interface ChoiceCardProps extends Omit, "title"> { title: React.ReactNode description?: React.ReactNode } /** Selectable block: title + description; selected = primary border + check. */ const ChoiceCard = React.forwardRef< React.ElementRef, ChoiceCardProps >(({ className, title, description, ...props }, ref) => ( {title} {description && {description}} )) ChoiceCard.displayName = "ChoiceCard" export { ChoiceCard, ChoiceCardGroup }
